name: Z.ai (Zhipu)

free_tier.notes: Listed as "Free" on the pricing page. GLM-4.6 and GLM-5.x are paid-only ($0.07-$4.4 per 1M tokens depending on model/direction).
Docs state limits are tied to plan tier (Max > Pro > Lite) but do not publish concrete req/min or tokens/min numbers for the free-tier models.

notes: Confirmed working end-to-end 2026-08-17: an existing API key (no fresh signup) returned 429 'Insufficient balance or no resource package' on the paid GLM-4.6 model, then succeeded (HTTP 200) on GLM-4.7-Flash with no balance top-up. So the free-tier models really are billed separately from the paid ones, not just throttled. Rate limits are not published, so treat this as usable-but-unbounded rather than a documented free tier; confidence is medium until someone publishes the actual req/min ceiling.
